methods.verified_title: How to Train a Shallow Ensemble
methods.saved_takeaway: Shared-backbone end-to-end shallow ensembles, GGN/Laplace head covariance sampling, exactly centered ensemble heads, and last-layer/full-model fine-tuning are established. Reported atomistic UQ covariance analysis distinguishes orientation from magnitude; it supplies no graph-classification gain.
methods.attributed_prior_vs_open_gap: Attribute useful head-covariance orientation, mean-preserving head samples and curvature-aware initialization. Candidate remains a finite graph-error VJP span choice at matched CE Jensen gap selected through one live coupled-Adam own-CE step, with all trial state discarded.
limits: No complete primary/code/search-exhaustiveness or novelty certificate
No transfer of UQ outcome to target accuracy
No Gaussian posterior claim at a short nonstationary warm point
new_baseline_proposals_only: Centered classification GGN-inspired or properly justified Laplace head initialization with matched continuation
Plain supervised gradient/SVD head span to isolate graph filtering

operation_assessment.exact_narrow_hypothesis: Graph-conditioned candidate restriction for centered private-head covariance selected for post-own-CE-step pooled TRAIN loss at matched mean raw logits and finite Jensen gap, followed by native continuation.
operation_assessment.possible_contribution: Useful graph span beyond equally selected random/permuted spans, fixed graph pair, warm-copy and competent ordinary ensemble controls.
